call_purpose: You wanted to sell your product with monthly and yearly plans on the same checkout page, send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and add GST to your prices.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added a yearly price in the product's Pricing section, and you confirmed both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout.

Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option in the product's Pages settings and saved it, and you confirmed a test purchase took you to your thank-you page.

covered.text: We mentioned there is a tax setting for adding GST to prices.

customer_next_steps.text: Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer.

support_next_steps.text: We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
